metadata.title: Polynomial-Time Algorithms for Links
metadata.abstract: Every link in the \(3\)-sphere admits a generalised \(T\)-link presentation. In this paper, we give an explicit polynomial-time algorithm which, given a signed Artin braid word and the number of strands, computes such a presentation. Combining this construction with Yamada--Vogel braiding gives a polynomial-time conversion from arbitrary oriented combinatorial link diagrams to generalised \(T\)-link parameters. We prove polynomial bounds on the number of strands and crossings in the resulting braid. As an application, we prove that a link property or a link invariant is computable in polynomial time from diagrams if and only if the corresponding problem is solvable in polynomial time from generalised \(T\)-link parameters, with parameter input measured by the total number of strands and crossings in the corresponding braid diagram. Whenever a classification criterion or an explicit invariant formula is available in these parameters, it can be applied to the original link by substituting the parameters obtained from the diagram. A polynomial-time test or evaluation then gives a polynomial-time procedure on diagrams. We also establish the corresponding transfer for approximating real-valued invariants to prescribed accuracy.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 链环表示的多项式时间转换
analysis.workSummary: 给定有符号 Artin 辫词及股数，显式多项式时间算法将其转换为 generalized T-link 参数；结合 Yamada–Vogel braiding，可从任意定向组合链环图进行转换，并控制所得股数与交叉数的多项式增长。由此在对应辫图总股数及交叉数作为参数输入规模时，图表示和该参数表示之间的性质判定、不变量计算及指定精度近似具有多项式时间可迁移性。
techniques: Artin 辫与 generalized T-link 转换
不变量算法与精度的复杂度迁移
analysis.breakthrough: 排除该表示转换本身的超多项式开销，使参数形式的有效判据可以传回普通链环图。
analysis.limitations: 并未给出所有结/链环问题的多项式时间算法：迁移结论要求参数端已有多项式判据或计算；输入规模按展开辫图的股数和交叉数衡量，不能擅自改为紧凑二进制整数参数长度。实值近似还需给定精度约定。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第29页明确披露大语言模型协助代数计算、显式参数变换、中间步骤组织核查、构造及其证明的改进、时间/存储/表示大小界核验、计算检验准备与稿件起草修改。相同声明明确研究问题、主要思想及一般方法由作者提出，故标写作、论证、核验及计算，不标ideas，也不臆定模型品牌。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.42077v1 · PDF 第29页，“Acknowledgements and use of AI tools”

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第29页明确披露大语言模型协助代数计算、显式参数变换、中间步骤组织核查、构造及其证明的改进、时间/存储/表示大小界核验、计算检验准备与稿件起草修改。相同声明明确研究问题、主要思想及一般方法由作者提出，故标写作、论证、核验及计算，不标ideas，也不臆定模型品牌。

analysis.priorityReason: 链环算法复杂度的通用转换工具有价值，需对输入编码和条件式应用保持清楚。
